reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Simple Icons (https://simpleicons.org/).
Technology stack: svg, javascript.
Component specification: 最后开 Disclaimer：项目是 CC0，单个品牌图标未必是。

Visual details from source observation: 我们打开官网，深色网格里每张卡都有品牌色和下载按钮。GitHub 仓库侧栏标 CC0-1.0，icons 目录就在文件列表里。我们点开 DISCLAIMER：项目本身是 CC0，但单个品牌图标可能另有许可和商标。适合要品牌符号的人；用之前按卡片上的许可和品牌指南核一遍，别把商标当自由素材。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
